title: Wasmtime 42.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a stack overflow vulnerability that allows guests to…
description: Wasmtime versions 42.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contain a stack overflow vulnerability. This flaw allows guest code to crash the host by creating a long chain of recursive types that trigger unbounded recursive drops, exhausting the host's stack.
